bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; modifying a prior appropriation for capital improvements at Neighborhood House in St. Paul; amending Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 14, subdivision 104.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 14, subdivision 104, is amended to read:

Subd. 104.
Wellstone Center

2,150,000

For a grant to the [-Neighborhood House-][+ city of St. Paul+] to renovate The Wellstone Center in the city of St. Paul.[+ This appropriation may be used to reimburse the city of St. Paul for costs paid for the project after June 2, 2023, but prior to execution of a grant agreement for the project. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; modifying a prior appropriation for capital improvements at Neighborhood House in St. Paul; amending Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 14, subdivision 104.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 14, subdivision 104, is amended to read:

Subd. 104.
Wellstone Center

2,150,000

For a grant to the city of St. Paul to renovate The Wellstone Center in the city of St. Paul. This appropriation may be used to reimburse the city of St. Paul for costs paid for the project after June 2, 2023, but prior to execution of a grant agreement for the project.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: This appropriation may be used to reimburse the city of St. Paul for costs paid for the project after June 2, 2023, but prior to execution of a grant agreement for the project.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
